init_agent_pop_params: initialize parameters for multiple agents of the same architecture using JAX vmap and split RNG keys
act_agent_pop: compute value, policy parameters, and next carry state across a population of agents in parallel
update_agent_pop: update training state for all agents in the population using vmap over individual agent updates
get_value_agent_pop: extract the value estimate from a population of agents given parameters, observations, and carry state
get_action_dist_agent_pop: get the action distribution from policy parameters for a population of agents with a specified dtype
